title: Improve your avatar images automatically
summary: When you upload an image on the LemonSlice platform, we automatically generate 3 variations. These recommendations adhere to our avatar style guide and are the easiest way to get great quality avatars.
body_markdown:
LemonSlice now makes it easier to create high-quality avatars from any photo. After you upload an image on our web platform, we'll automatically generate a selection of alternative source images that better follow our avatar best practices - improving details like composition, framing, lighting, and overall portrait quality while staying true to the original. Simply choose the version you like best before generating your avatar. It's a small addition to the workflow that consistently leads to better-looking and more expressive results.
